'''Pune Zignat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and a chief weapons [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who helped [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]]<ref name=":0" /> as [[Aide/Legends|aide]]<ref name="SWArchive-The Clone Wars Episode Guide: Defenders of Peace">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode014.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Defenders of Peace}}</ref> to test his new [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliator]] missiles on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. During the [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|Defense of Maridun]], he relayed the firing orders to the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s operating the Defoliator. He managed to survive the battle but was captured along with Durd.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Traits==
Pune Zignat also wore a pair of electronic [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]],<ref name="DOP" /> similar to [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] [[Tey How/Legends|Tey How's]] goggles.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>
